questions.q: Which round mostly tests Python and pandas under a time limit?
why: No code is written in the recruiter call.
Correct: the coding or OA round tests code under a clock.
Behavioural rounds test stories, not code.
System design tests the whole system, not syntax.

questions.q: In an ML system design round you hear a vague prompt. What do you do first?
options: Ask clarifying questions about decision, horizon and data
why: Model choice comes after the goal.
Correct: questions about the decision, the horizon, and the data come first.
Monitoring comes at the end of the design.
The cloud provider is a late detail.

questions.q: Your OA has three problems in 75 minutes. Which plan is the best?
options: Spend 70 minutes on the hardest problem
Solve the easiest first, then the next, and leave time to test
Read all problems and solve none until the last 10 minutes
why: One problem can eat the whole time and leave zero points on the others.
Correct: secure easy points first, then use the rest of the time well.
Waiting wastes the clock.
Hidden tests check edge cases, so skipping them loses points.

questions.q: A candidate studied only ARIMA. Which round is most at risk?
why: Correct: a design round needs data, serving, and monitoring, not one model.
The recruiter call does not test ARIMA.
Studying one topic leaves other rounds open.
Behavioural is also at risk, but design is the larger gap.

questions.q: Scenario: you are a senior candidate. Which statement is true?
options: Design and trade-off judgement weigh more than at junior level
why: Many senior loops keep a coding round.
Correct: the weight moves toward design and judgement.
Fundamentals are still tested, often with harder 'why' questions.
Several rounds feed the final decision.

questions.q: You rate coding 2/5 and behavioural 5/5. How should you split study time?
options: More on coding, but keep some time on behavioural
why: Equal time wastes hours on a strong area.
Correct: weighted by weakness, with a small refresh of strong areas.
Zero time on a strong round lets it decay.
Behavioural is your strongest round.
